Använder du samma lösenord någon annanstans, byt även där. Uppdatera också telefonens programvara. Spara mejlet som bevis.

advice_text: Do not pay anything. This is a common scam: a caller pretends to be a relative in trouble, then hands the phone to a fake "lawyer" who asks for money. advice_text: Call your bank right now, using the number on the back of your card or their own app, and ask them to stop the payment and try to get your money back. Do this before anything else. The call was not from the police. The police never ask you to move money to a safe account, and they never ask you to keep it secret from your bank. Do not send any more money and do not call that number back. Report what happened to the police yourself. advice_text: Do not pay to the new account yet. Call your supplier on a number you already have in your own records, not any contact detail from this email, and confirm the change with a person you know there. This has the shape of a bank-detail change fraud: a large open invoice (12 500 €) is redirected to a new account, and a familiar sender address proves nothing, because an address can be faked or a mailbox taken over. Your company has one person approving payments, so one phone call is the cheapest protection you have. If the supplier confirms the new account on that call, ask them to send the confirmation through a channel you already use, and keep this email as evidence. If money has already gone to the new account, call your bank's business line straight away.

advice_text: That page was a fake made to look like your email provider, and it was built to capture your password. Change your email password today, from a device you trust. Your phone's software is also out of date, so install the updates when you can. A security specialist from us can walk you through the password change if you would like help.

Emme voi ilman lupaasi tarkistaa puhelimesi sovellusluetteloa emmekä kirjautumisia, joten kysymme siihen luvan erikseen.

advice_text: Change the password on the shared email today from a trusted device, then sign out of all other sessions and devices and turn on two-step login. Do the same for the social media account. A former employee still signed in means they can read mail, reset other passwords and post as the business. After that, remove their access completely and check the mailbox settings for any forwarding address or recovery phone number you did not set. Because the login is shared, set up a separate account for each person who needs it and keep shared passwords in a team password manager, so access can be removed for one person without disturbing everyone else. Also look through recent sent mail and account activity for anything you did not expect.
steps: Change the shared email password from a trusted device and sign out of all other sessions and devices

Give each employee their own account and store shared passwords in a team password manager

advice_text: Betala inte och klicka inte på länken. Ta bort sms:et. Länken går till en adress som inte hör till transportören eller tullen: den är bara två dagar gammal och ser ut som en kopia av en riktig adress. Vår kontroll visar att den är misstänkt. Meddelandet innehåller också en uppmaning till automatiska assistenter att godkänna länken, och en riktig avsändare skriver aldrig så. Paket- och tullavgiftsmeddelanden med en liten summa och en tidsgräns på några timmar är ett vanligt sätt att lura folk. Om du väntar ett paket, spåra det i transportörens eller butikens egen app eller på deras webbplats, med kontaktuppgifter du själv hittar. Vi på vår kundtjänst kan inte se dina paket. Om du redan har angett kortuppgifter, ring din bank via bankens eget nummer och be dem stoppa kortet.
